summary.en: Oncology research includes targeted small molecules and an ADC, while the September bofanglutide license expands metabolic development. ([Company profile](https://www.menarini.com/content/dam/menarini-com/assets/about-us/documents/ITA_Company_Profile.pdf); [license](https://www.menarini.com/en-us/news/news-detail/gan-lee-and-menarini-group-partner-to-advance-bofanglutide-in-europe.html))
summary.zh: 肿瘤研究包括靶向小分子和一款 ADC,而 9 月的 bofanglutide 许可扩大了代谢领域的开发。([Company profile](https://www.menarini.com/content/dam/menarini-com/assets/about-us/documents/ITA_Company_Profile.pdf); [license](https://www.menarini.com/en-us/news/news-detail/gan-lee-and-menarini-group-partner-to-advance-bofanglutide-in-europe.html))

next.en: Global Phase 3 program planned; China pivotal trial completed
next.zh: 计划开展全球 III 期项目;中国关键性试验已完成

ind.zh: 复发/难治性侵袭性 B 细胞非霍奇金淋巴瘤

next.en: JASPIS-01 data at ASH on December 13
next.zh: JASPIS-01 数据将于 12 月 13 日在 ASH 公布

ind.en: Advanced breast cancer (Phase 2, active); an earlier Phase 1b/2 study in metastatic colorectal cancer is completed
ind.zh: 晚期乳腺癌(II 期,进行中);此前在转移性结直肠癌中开展的 Ib/II 期研究已完成

ind.en: Breast cancer; also solid and hematologic tumors
ind.zh: 乳腺癌;另有实体瘤和血液肿瘤

watch.en: Dapolsertib's first JASPIS-01 clinical data are scheduled for ASH in December 2026.
watch.zh: Dapolsertib 的首批 JASPIS-01 临床数据定于 2026 年 12 月在 ASH 公布。

watch.en: Bofanglutide's European license includes €62 million upfront and up to €664 million in milestones.
watch.zh: Bofanglutide 的欧洲许可包括 €62 million 首付款和最高 €664 million 的里程碑付款。

watch.en: The preclinical GIM-621 license includes $45 million in upfront and near-term payments.
watch.zh: 临床前项目 GIM-621 的许可包括 $45 million 的首付款和近期付款。

watch.en: The oncology portfolio also contains approved elacestrant and tagraxofusp with indication-expansion trials.
watch.zh: 肿瘤产品组合还包括已获批的 elacestrant 和 tagraxofusp,并正在开展适应症扩展试验。

gaps: Group pipeline tables did not expose asset rows in browser text; the current company profile and Stemline page were also read. No latest quarterly or half-year financial release was located for this private company.

The English company profile used for MEN1611 predates June 2026; the current Stemline page still lists its breast and colorectal trials, but numerical phase markers were not recoverable there. Phase 2 comes from the older profile and may be stale.
Origins were not verified for dapolsertib, MEN1611, MEN1309, MEN2312 or MEN2501; origin is null. Bofanglutide's precise modality was not explicitly verified; modality is null.
Bofanglutide phase 3 refers to the completed China pivotal study, not an already-started European Phase 3 trial; the global program has no disclosed start date.
No company-reported totals by phase were verified; counts is null. Dates for other next milestones were not disclosed or verified.
Approved elacestrant, tagraxofusp, selinexor and obicetrapib are excluded because a pending filing for a major new indication was not verified. Preclinical assets are excluded.
